permitted_claim: A genuine browser-owned sidebar, the retained staff-016 Requirements view and two failed follow-ups were observed. The scoped approval cleared this capture controller's origin gate, not the separate sidebar attachment problem.

host_route: Before response reports authorised CDP native page tools, not dedicated WebMCP. Both new follow-ups report a detached developer connection and return no staff-039 table. Controller native accessibility/screenshot access succeeded after the scoped origin approval.
manual_capture_steps: Open the supplied tools_workbench URL in a clean already-authorised browser window. Do not show unrelated tabs, account identifiers or chat history.
Through the already-authorised sidebar, send turn 1 exactly as printed in specification/01-codex-screenshot-instructions.md. Stop if new permission is requested.
Save genuine whole-window Requirements capture, actual tool schemas/arguments/outputs and snapshot/result/revision identities.
Send turn 2 exactly once; capture the actual staff-039 Interactions transition, including 1–3 of 4/partial status if returned.
Keep native CDP use distinct from dedicated WebMCP. Without a permitted route, retain this blocked status.

sidebar_turn_accounting.note: The owner started a new conversation after the parent attempt. These counts describe visible submitted turns, not underlying model calls or usage.

tool_schemas_note: No completed raw sidebar schema-discovery output was retained. Tool names in the before response are self-reported, not a captured invocation transcript.

state_transition.reason: Both completed sidebar responses report developer-connection attachment failure; the native window still contains staff-016 Requirements. No manual case/view click was used to simulate the transition.
